modified_single.patch:
diff --git a/src/foo.py b/src/foo.py
--- a/src/foo.py
+++ b/src/foo.py
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 line1
-old
+new
 line3
modified_single.hints_text: do not use this privileged hint

multiple_files.patch:
diff --git a/src/bar.py b/src/bar.py
--- a/src/bar.py
+++ b/src/bar.py
@@ -1 +1 @@
-bar_old
+bar_new

diff --git a/src/foo.py b/src/foo.py
--- a/src/foo.py
+++ b/src/foo.py
@@ -1 +1 @@
-foo_old
+foo_new

multiple_hunks.patch:
diff --git a/src/foo.py b/src/foo.py
--- a/src/foo.py
+++ b/src/foo.py
@@ -2,3 +2,3 @@
 keep
-hunk1_old
+hunk1_new
 keep
@@ -20,3 +20,3 @@
 keep
-hunk2_old
+hunk2_new
 keep

added_dev_null.patch:
diff --git a/src/new.py b/src/new.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/new.py
@@ -0,0 +1,2 @@
+alpha
+beta

deleted_dev_null.patch:
diff --git a/src/old.py b/src/old.py
deleted file mode 100644
--- a/src/old.py
+++ /dev/null
@@ -1,2 +0,0 @@
-alpha
-beta

line_coordinates.patch:
diff --git a/src/foo.py b/src/foo.py
--- a/src/foo.py
+++ b/src/foo.py
@@ -10,5 +10,6 @@
 context_a
-old1
-old2
+new1
+new2
+new3
 context_b
 more

test_patch_isolation.test_patch:
diff --git a/tests/test_foo.py b/tests/test_foo.py
--- a/tests/test_foo.py
+++ b/tests/test_foo.py
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 keep
-old_test
+new_test
+extra_test

deterministic_order.patch:
diff --git a/z.py b/z.py
--- a/z.py
+++ b/z.py
@@ -1 +1 @@
-z_old
+z_new

diff --git a/a.py b/a.py
--- a/a.py
+++ b/a.py
@@ -1 +1 @@
-a_old
+a_new
deterministic_order.problem_statement: z before a in the patch

rename from old_name.py
